name: Wingspan
shortDescription: A calm engine-building game about attracting birds, chaining habitats, and timing food, eggs, and cards.
strategyNotes: Start with birds that give reliable food or card access so later turns are less dependent on the feeder and tray.
Build one strong habitat early, then use bonus cards and end-round goals to decide whether to branch out.
Eggs are flexible points and action fuel, so avoid leaving egg production until the final round unless another engine is already scoring well.

name: Terraforming Mars
shortDescription: A card-driven strategy game about developing an economy while racing to make Mars habitable.
strategyNotes: Prioritize production in the first generations, especially money and cards that compound over several rounds.
Track milestone and award timing; claiming one before an opponent often matters more than squeezing out a perfect value turn.
Shift from engine growth to terraforming and city scoring once the game clock starts accelerating.

name: Azul
shortDescription: A tactile tile-drafting game about pattern building, tempo, and denying opponents clean placements.
strategyNotes: Watch the factory offer before committing to long rows, because one forced color can turn into avoidable floor penalties.
Complete center columns and color sets when they align naturally, but do not chase bonuses at the cost of repeated waste.
Late in each round, count what opponents cannot legally place and use that pressure to leave them awkward drafts.
